original_question: What happens if a student misses a makeup exam?
reference_answer: A student may apply for a makeup examination where he/she is not able to attend the examination schedule due to reasons of personal medical condition or compassionate reason like death of a very close relative. No other contingencies are acceptable.
gold_evidence_quotes: ["In case a student misses the make-up Examination also, then no further chance will be provided."]
